Country charts retain all countries and require scrolling.
No global date/country dashboard filter or cross-filter/drillthrough action existed in the original workbook; none is claimed.
Complete tooltip usability, every country scroll position, phone layout and live MySQL refresh were not tested.
Sales include anonymous customers; customer rankings and distinct customer counts require a customer ID.
